text.tspan: Powered from the RP4 3.3 V pin so DO
can never exceed the GPIO's 3.3 V.
Faces the propeller: one DO pulse
3.3 V only, never 5 V: the module pulls
SDA and SCL up to its own VCC. The RP4
board has 1.8 kΩ pull-ups to 3.3 V on
GPIO2 and GPIO3; no resistors are added.
Module jumper or bridge set for 3.3 V.
DIR on GND fixes the count direction.
Faces a magnet on the motor shaft end,
Flyback protection: the internal clamp diodes on
section 9.3.1, rated to 1 A). No external diodes.
PARMCO Checkpoint 3 motor, IR sensor and encoder schematic (AI-generated)
All ground symbols are one net: RP4 GND (J1 pins 9, 14, 20 and 25), supply GND, U1 pins 4, 5, 12, 13.
All +5 V and +12 V symbols come from PS1. Only U3 and U4 are powered from the RP4 (3.3 V, J1 pins 17 and 1).
J1 numbers are header pin numbers. U2 pins 3 (NC) and 6 (base), U4 OUT and PGO are left unconnected.
